en.hubeali: H 14936 – A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazi’e, from Munzar in Jayfar, from Hisham Bin Saalim who said:

I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying:  ‘Travel when it is cool (time of the day)’. I said, ‘We are afraid of the pests’. So heasws said: ‘Even if something affects you, it is better for you in view to the fact that you will be safe (from sunstroke), as you are the protected ones (from pets)’.
en.sarwar: 489. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said: ‘The Rasool Allah (saww) said: ‘It is on you to travel at night, for the ground folds up at night’.
